notes.title: Little Gods of the Abyss – Preparing for Full Release
notes.content: [h3]Little Gods of the Abyss – Preparing for Full Release[/h3][p]We are entering the final stage of polishing for the [b]full release[/b] of [i]Little Gods of the Abyss[/i]. After gathering player feedback and countless tests, we’ve refined the game to offer smoother controls, improved features, and an even more engaging experience.[/p][p]Players can now look forward to:[/p][list][*][p][b]More mechanics and traps[/b], bringing fresh challenges and strategies.[/p][/*][*][p]A greater variety of [b]stages[/b], providing new adventures to explore.[/p][/*][*][p]Better overall [b]playability and responsiveness[/b], making the action more immersive.[/p][/*][/list][p]The full release is not the end, but the beginning of continuous updates and improvements. We hope you’ll dive in and enjoy the expanded world of [i]Little Gods of the Abyss[/i]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38213543/b42e6f54d744190e2eb2df2a4e1f94bf7f7a1463.gif"][/img][/p]
